observations.finding: 2 of 50 pathways significant at BH-q<0.05; top pathways include PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS (SMD=+1.06, q=0.0049) and HEME_METABOLISM (SMD=+0.76, q=0.014).
No mutations significant at BH-q<0.05; top trend is PBRM1 higher frequency (65% vs 31.3%, OR=4.07, 95% CI 1.45-11.4, p=0.009, q=0.201).

One continuous feature significant at BH-q<0.05: chr20q lower (Cliff's delta=-0.544, q=0.026); top gain/loss trends include chr14q loss lower (15% vs 47%, OR=0.20, 95% CI 0.05-0.73, q=0.139) and chr5q gain higher (65% vs 33.7%, OR=3.65, 95% CI 1.31-10.2, q=0.197).

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows FDR-significant upregulation of pancreatic beta cell and heme metabolism pathways. WXS shows a strong PBRM1 enrichment trend that does not survive FDR. CNV shows a significant chr20q decrease and suggestive chr5q gain. The RNA and CNV signals are partially coherent (both indicate distinct genomic/transcriptomic profile), but mutation evidence is not FDR-significant.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set exhibits a distinct expression and copy-number profile, but the lack of FDR-significant mutation enrichment tempers any claim of a specific mutational driver.
limitations: Only 2 RNA pathways and 1 CNV feature are FDR-significant.
PBRM1 mutation enrichment is not FDR-significant.
Small set size (n=20) and multiple testing reduce confidence.

Overall, the set has some multimodal support, primarily from WSI and RNA.
cross_modal_consistency.medical_interpretation: The set shows partial multimodal cohesion, with WSI and RNA as main drivers.
limitations: Resampling was performed on existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows strong FDR-significant downregulation of myogenesis and Wnt signaling, with upregulation of inflammatory and IL6-JAK-STAT3 pathways. WXS shows strong BAP1 and SPTA1 enrichment trends that approach but do not reach FDR significance (q=0.097 and 0.170). CNV shows no FDR-significant findings. The RNA signal is robust and coherent with an inflammatory/immune phenotype, partially supported by BAP1 mutation trend.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The RNA pattern suggests an inflammatory and immune-active state, possibly associated with BAP1 alterations, but the mutation evidence is not FDR-significant.
limitations: BAP1 and SPTA1 mutation trends are not FDR-significant.
CNV lacks FDR-significant findings.
Small set size (n=11) limits power.
